emails.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for your message.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 36 months, 90,000 kits in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 4.94 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract. This amounts to about EUR 444,600 over the term.
3. Basis: We want one partner for the complete kit, which bundles parts we buy from several suppliers today. Our kit calculation: at your own current prices (19 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8 at EUR 12.46/100; 21 x Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 at EUR 4.91/100; 23 x Washer ISO 7089 M12 at EUR 12.78/1000) plus the part you do not supply us yet (6 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 at today's EUR 37.64/100), the kit costs EUR 5.95. Your offer of EUR 5.74 is a 3.5% bundle discount for the whole kit on a multi-year single-source volume; we consider EUR 4.94 a fair kit price. That is about EUR 188,700 a year, around 5 times our current business with you. Our demand forecast for this part is up +6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09), and we commit 574,000 units a year. Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products changed -1.6% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2594@2024-10, idx:PPI-C2594@2025-10).
4. Next step: You told us that price changes above 2% need your pricing committee. Please put this proposal to your pricing committee: a binding 36-month agreement for 90,000 kits, about EUR 444,600. On the committee's written confirmation we issue the order the same day, and we pay every invoice on the due date.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for your message.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 36 months, 90,000 kits in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 5.10 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract. This amounts to about EUR 459,000 over the term.
3. Basis: As calculated, your own current prices give EUR 5.95 per kit; our offer reflects a fair bundle discount for a multi-year single-source agreement. That is about EUR 188,700 a year, around 5 times our current business with you. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
